verdict.rationale: Sentry documents its own MCP server (/product/sentry-mcp/), which connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading docs and managing projects. It also supports org/project scoping, and MCP access is listed even on the free plan. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, documented connection/auth/transport setup details.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading documentation, and managing projects — all via the Model Context Protocol.
When scoped, tools automatically default to the constrained org/project and unnecessary discovery tools are hidden.
